title: Liverpool-Atletico leads Matchday 1's second night with Arsenal at Napoli and PSG at home to Bratislava
summary: Champions League Matchday 1's second slate on Wednesday September 9 begins with Barcelona hosting Feyenoord and VfB Stuttgart welcoming Viking FK, before the evening session sends Liverpool to Anfield against Atletico Madrid, PSG to the Parc des Princes against Slovan Bratislava, Sporting CP against Galatasaray, and Napoli against Arsenal in a rematch of last season's run to the final. The Opta supercomputer tips Liverpool at 53% pre-match. Five Premier League clubs entered the draw, with Arsenal drawing Real Madrid and Bayern, City drawing PSG and Barcelona, and United facing Bayern.
